messages:
morgan: Heads-up — support reported a customer getting double-billed during an SSE reconnect loop. They see two responses for the same user request and two tokens charged. No obvious errors in their client code.

sam: repro steps? was it a network flake or explicit resume? :eyes:

morgan: Repro from their logs: client loses connection, retries immediately, gets an SSE stream that replays the last chunk and then the full response. They used our JS sdk with default reconnect.

priya: Is their request hitting a sticky routing backend? If session-affinity routes to a different instance on reconnect we might replay from start. That would cause duplicate generation + billing.

jason: We currently treat a reconnect with a new connection id as a distinct request for billing. Resume semantics (Last-Event-ID / event id) are used only for client-side resume, but server doesn’t dedupe tokens.

lee: Right — sticky routing + no resume-dedupe = replay hazard. We do have prefix KVCACHE that can dedupe partials, but only within the same runtime shard. Cross-shard reconnects lose that state.

morgan: Also noticed telemetry: console shows the original request as completed and the resumed stream as another completed call. There's no field that ties the two together in the dashboard. Hard to correlate in Billing/Console.

devx-bot: @channel new incident created: INC-2026 SSE-RECONNECT-BILLING (automated capture).

sam: Proposed fix: add an idempotency token propagated to the runtime (x-rdwd-session-id) generated by client per logical user request. On server side, if an idempotency token is seen within N seconds and the response is still available, stream resume instead of charging twice.

priya: Agree on idempotency header. We should also persist a small in-memory mapping (token -> last-offset, last-charge-txid) and make billing pipeline consult it. For cross-shard, the routing layer must route resumes to the same shard or consult a global resume store.

jason: Two implementation paths: 1) sticky-route resumes (easy, but harms DR/cross-region failover), 2) global resume index (more work but correct). Which do we want for GA?

lee: We can do hybrid: try sticky routing first, if miss, fallback to global store. But that still requires the client to include a resume id. Changing routing policies affects many customers.

morgan: UX/rollout note: we need a Console toggle per-tenant for "resume-safe mode" to opt-in before we change billing behavior. Also dashboard needs a new telemetry tag to link resume attempts: resume.id and resume.reason (client-flap, server-eof, auth-rotation).

priya: Telemetry schema proposal (short): `resume_id`, `resume_attempt`, `resume_result`, `orig_conn_id`, `new_conn_id`, `billing_op_id`. These are needed to debug postmortem and to build the alerting rule.

oncall: Can we add an alert: if same resume_id generates >1 billing_op within 30s, fire P3? We need to catch regressions.

jason: Also add client guidance in SDK: include `Last-Event-ID` in reconnect and set exponential backoff to avoid immediate dual receipts. Example client fix snippet: `const es = new EventSource(url); es.onopen = () => { if (lastEventId) es.addEventListener('open', () => fetch(url + '?lastEventId=' + lastEventId)); }` — but we should provide a nicer `reconnectWithResume(sessionId)` helper.

morgan: Quick mitigation: patch API gateway to reject duplicate immediate reconnects without `x-rdwd-session-id` if `feature_flag.resume_safe` enabled for tenant. That gives us safety while we implement global resume index.

lee: Beware billing pipeline: it currently treats event streams as invoice-able per connection. We'll need a downstream change to consult resume metadata before emit. I've filed BILL-482 to track.

priya: I'll draft telemetry change and a small proto for resume headers. jason, can you scope gateway change? morgan, can you coordinate tenant rollout toggle in console?

jason: I'll scope gateway quick patch (expect a couple days). If we go the sticky-first approach we can deliver fast.

morgan: Action items: priya -> telemetry proto + event schema; jason -> gateway patch PR; lee -> billing impact doc; morgan -> console toggle + incident customer comms.

sam: One more thing: update replay tests in stress harness to simulate cross-shard reconnects. Found a flaky test last week that might mask this.

morgan: Thanks. I'll post summary and RFC link here once priya's schema is ready. :thumbsup:
